entries.name: Squat Jump — settled quarter-squat start
entries.instruction: Main knee/hip force from a still start, expressed vertically. exercises.name: Seated band hip internal rotation
exercises.rest: 60 s between side bouts; 10 total reps; 90 s before the next lift preparation
exercises.purpose: Keep the working load at 2–3 technical reps/cycles in reserve. Load controlled internal-rotation torque directly at the hip, complementing the larger leg push used to organise the selected grounded lower turn. Sit on a stable bench with thighs supported and hips and knees near 90 degrees. Fit a secure loop around the lower shins. Keep the other foot planted while the working foot moves a short distance outward, lightly clear of the floor, through hip internal rotation. Keep that knee and the pelvis still. Take 2 seconds outward and 2 seconds returning; do not force end range or twist the knee or ankle. Use instead: Reduce range or band tension for knee, ankle or pelvic movement. If the loop cannot be fitted securely, use self-resisted seated hip internal rotation with the opposite hand resisting the outside of the lower shin instead; manual resistance is a changed and less reproducible load. Apply this change only to the same remaining combined dose and recovery; it replaces the original execution and adds no extra task or make-up attempts. exercises.name: Landmine Rotation
exercises.rest: Finish this working bout; no additional set or finisher is prescribed.
exercises.purpose: Keep the working load at 2–3 technical reps/cycles in reserve. Load the turning arc and controlled endpoints that transmit lower-body force into the selected upper rotational action. Secure the landmine and qualify the bar, grip and minimum load. Hold the sleeve or suitable grip in both hands with elbows softly bent. Turn the feet and hips with a modest side-to-side loaded arc while keeping ribs over pelvis. Each one-way traverse is one rep; the return is the next counted rep. Take about 2 seconds per traverse and settle briefly at each endpoint. Avoid trunk lean, a trapped knee or an uncontrolled finish. Use instead: Reduce the load or arc for loss of alignment. If a secured, manageable landmine setup cannot be qualified, use a standing two-hand band rotation with a verified side anchor and the same one-way traverse counting instead; log the changed setup. Apply this change only to the same remaining combined dose and recovery; it replaces the original execution and adds no extra task or make-up attempts. explosive_progression_note: Squat Jump — settled quarter-squat start establishes the still-start vertical-force reference, paired with Medicine Ball Chest Pass — stationary, paused for a still-base forward release. The grounded hip pivot and paused rotational scoop add turn initiation without a kick or additional foot reception. Prescribed baseline: 13 ball releases, 6 bilateral foot-landing events, 0 bilateral hand-receiving events. Before delivery, review actual recent loading and recovery; require the held squat start without a second dip, a controlled two-foot finish and a quiet-trunk chest release. If flight cannot be controlled, use the listed fast nonflight squat rise for only the remaining E1 attempts and record removed landings; keep full resets and add no test attempts.
